title: Ponytail: 335 lines → 10
musicPrompt: Sleek minimal product-launch bed for a 60-second tech short, about 100 BPM, soft analog synth pulses, warm sub bass, crisp light hi-hats and glassy plucks, a small lift when the counter falls to ten around 16 seconds and a calm resolve into the end card, instrumental, no vocals.

scenes.text: You ask your AI for a date picker. In one test, it wrote three hundred and thirty-five lines.
Welcome to Claude Skills, by Curiously.
This is Ponytail, a free skill with over a hundred and ninety thousand GitHub stars.
That's the maker's test. Without the skill, Claude reached for a calendar library.
With Ponytail, ten lines. It reused the project's input box, and the browser brings the calendar.
The trick: a ladder of questions. Does this need to exist? Is it already in your code, or the browser? Only then does it write the minimum. Security is never cut.
It's for anyone reviewing AI code. The catch: coding only, and those numbers are the maker's. In our small test, plain Claude was already lean.
We use it ourselves. Install it with two commands, link in the description.
If you like this kind of content, like, share and follow Curiously.
